patterns.what_worked: Reproduced the '**' trap against the shipped AceDB library before touching code (plain read created + rawset a defaults table), then proved the fix over a real AceDB:New profile with reloads, key counts and mutation proofs. The == true marker decision came from a verified fact (the defective code never reached its write), not from taste.
patterns.what_was_hard: A concurrent lane (ranged-forced) was editing bars.lua and tests/bars_state.lua during this session, so two gate runs straddled its writes and the tree was transiently red; had to bracket the final gate with sha256 pre/post to get a trustworthy 54/0. Also had to correct an interim orchestrator reconcile that claimed a theme_preset rawget change the code does not have.
patterns.skill_gap: Sweep of the same trap was static + targeted dynamic; the options tree cannot be dynamically instrumented in this suite (options_load_state uses a plain stub profile), so render-time reads are classified by reading code, not execution.

escalation.recommendation: Release-blocking follow-up: widgets.lua:44-46 latent sound_channel metatable read (needs a rawget/type guard). Operator still owes the four in-client checks in bench/appearance_fix_2026-10-28.md section 9.
